neighbours.caption: Partial hydatidiform mole. Enlarged villi are surrounded by a “lacy” proliferation of syncytiotrophoblast. Note the irregular outline of some villi (bottom).

Non specific interstitial pneumonia. A mesh-like fibrosis of the alveolar septa is seen. Fibroblastic foci are not found. Aggregates of lymphocytes are sometimes found (HE, original magnification 40x).
lung tissue and cartilage; sacrococcygeal teratoma
Usual interstitial pneumonia. The UIP pattern shows honey combing and fibroblastic foci (haematoxylin eosin stain (HE), original magnification 100x).

full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of placental tissue. It shows enlarged chorionic villi with an irregular outline, surrounded by a proliferation of trophoblastic tissue including syncytiotrophoblast. These histological features are characteristic of a partial hydatidiform mole.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of breast tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image displays multiple ductal structures exhibiting a cribriform-like growth pattern characteristic of ductal carcinoma in situ. The proliferation of atypical epithelial cells forms gland-like spaces within the ducts.
